page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is a dedicated compute instance belonging to the high clock speed family, operating on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The system provisions 32 virtual CPUs derived from 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU subsystem is configured with 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. It incorporates vector instruction extensions including AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI, along with hardware-assisted cryptographic AES instructions.

Memory capacity is configured at 128.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Benchmark testing demonstrates sustained uncached memory throughput of 109.89 GB/sec for read operations and 48.22 GB/sec for write operations on large blocks, paired with cached throughput reaching 1705.41 GB/sec. The instance does not feature local storage volumes or dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage architectures. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps without bundled complimentary public IPv4 addressing.

Benchmark outcomes show reliable processing across multi-threaded and compute-heavy profiles. Synthetic stress-ng testing records a single-core score of 1436.68 and a multi-core score of 30666.35, while Geekbench evaluates single-core at 1287.0 and multi-core at 11107.0. Software compilation under Clang achieved 23704.0, while decompression workloads scaled to 140.98 GB/sec in multi-threaded bzip3. In distributed caching environments, the configuration managed 28.91 million Redis SET operations per second alongside 21.45 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

With its 1:4 processor-to-memory configuration and high CPU base frequency, ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is technically aligned with enterprise relational database servers, Redis in-memory caches, software compilation clusters, web serving fleets, and CPU-driven batch processing. Systems that demand extreme write IOPS or massive local scratch storage require provisioning separate high-performance block storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is a high clock speed virtual server provisioned on the KVM hypervisor, powered by a 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY x86_64 processor. The instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs (16 physical cores) and 128.0 GB of system memory, matching a 1:4 core-to-memory ratio. It supports advanced vector compute through AVX-512 and VNNI extensions. The server does not bundle local disk storage or hardware GPU accelerators, delegating data persistence to external storage networks over a 10 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark results indicate balanced performance, registering a PassMark CPU score of 29517.51 and 28.91 million Redis SET operations per second. The hardware configuration makes this server well adapted for software compilation, static web serving, in-memory caching, and relational database hosting.
